newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks firm in thin trade after June CPI.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks firm in thin trade after June CPI.

text.p: MADRID, July 11 (Reuter) 0825 GMT - Madrid share prices were slightly higher in relatively thin early trade on Friday, in line with other major bourses, dealers said.
June inflation, 1.6 percent year on year versus 1.5 percent in May, broadly met market expectations and thus had little effect, dealers said.
* General index up 1.37 points, 0.22 percent, to 622.94
* Focus stays with banks, with Banesto due to kick off the first half reporting season today. Banesto up 10 pesetas to 1,495. BBV up 80 pesetas to 12,810, Santander sheds 25 pesetas to 4,785.

Electrical company Endesa outperformed the indices, adding 30 pesetas to 12,460, after the announcement that its group had won the bid for the 70 percent stake of Retevision, Spain's future second telephone operator.
June's consumer price index, which climbed 1.6 percent year on year versus 1.5 percent in May, came in as expected and had little effect on the market, dealers said.
Trading volume, with around 34 billion pesetas changing hands, was lower than usual.
